capabilities: insert the current time with the elapsed time since the reference timestamp
reset the reference timestamp to the current time via a command
keep a running reference point across successive log entries
extras: The author describes the plugin as barebones, made for personal use, and rigid in its current state, welcoming contributions and format-setting suggestions.
motivation: The author built it for food logs, diaries, and similar notes where the time span between entries is not obvious at a glance.
problem: Timestamped log entries show clock times only, so the size of the gap between two entries is hard to grasp without doing mental math.
summary: Timestamp logger that inserts the current time plus the elapsed time since a chosen reference timestamp into notes.
